originalTitle: M-cap of five of top 10 most valued firms jumps Rs 1.54 lakh cr; TCS biggest winner
simplifiedContent: Here's what happened in the stock market: the value of five of the biggest companies in India went up by a total of Rs 1.54 lakh crore last week. The biggest gain was seen by Tata Consultancy Services, whose value increased by Rs 72,072.3 crore. Some other big companies like ICICI Bank and Reliance Industries also saw their values go up, but HDFC Bank and Bharti Airtel saw their values decrease. This is important because it shows that the Indian stock market had a good week overall. The increase in value of these big companies helped the market end the week on a strong note.

originalTitle: Axis Bank standalone profit soars 23% in Q1
simplifiedContent: Axis Bank, a major bank in India, recently announced that its profit increased by 23% compared to the same time last year. This means the bank made more money than it did a year ago. The bank's profit grew because it had to set aside less money for potential losses, even though its main business activities didn't grow very much (only 1.3%). This is important because it shows that the bank is performing well and making more money. The increase in profit is a positive sign for the bank and its investors.

originalTitle: Axis Bank Standalone Profit Soars 23% in Q1
simplifiedContent: Axis Bank, a private bank in India, made a lot more money in the first quarter of this year compared to the same time last year. The bank's profit increased by 23% to ₹7,114 crore, which means it made ₹1,308 crore more than it did last year. The bank also made more money from its daily operations, with ₹11,659 crore in pre-provision operating profit. This is good news for the bank and its investors, as it shows the bank is doing well financially. This increase in profit matters because it can affect the bank's stock price and the return on investment for people who own shares in the bank.
